takes.h: Clive Barker's Library of the Dead: three anthologies, quarterly
takes.p: Clive Barker's Library of the Dead is a series of three hardcover anthologies, Fear Eternal, Pyres of Bedlam and Dark Descents, released quarterly through 2027. They are Kickstarter exclusives, with leather and limited editions and illustrations by Barker, according to Daily Dead.

Subterranean Press has a preorder page for a limited trade edition of Robert McCammon's Baal, one of the first two titles in the Lividian McCammon Library. The page lists the book as “to be published in Fall.”

takes.h: Synapse sets The Deadly Spawn for 4K UHD and Blu-ray
takes.p: Synapse Films will release Douglas McKeown's The Deadly Spawn on November 10, with separate 4K UHD and Blu-ray editions, according to Why So Blu.

takes.h: NECA brings back the Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning Leatherface
takes.p: NECA is reissuing its Leatherface set from The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning for the film's twentieth anniversary. Pre-orders opened October 6, according to Dread Central.
